The '''Spinnaker Navy''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]] that guarded the coastal [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Prima" /> The Navy was part of the [[Naboo Royal Navy]], a division of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] that served the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]]. The [[Boat/Legends|boats]] in the Navy included five [[Scout (Royal Naboo)|Light Scouts]], four [[Destroyer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Destroyers]], and two [[Cruiser (Naboo)|Naboo Cruisers]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Spinnaker was [[Invasion of Spinnaker|attacked]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet.<ref name="GB" /> As the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] cleared out the city, [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]] destroyed the Spinnaker Navy's vessels while staying out of range of the city's [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air defenses]].<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spinnaker Navy was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]], published on on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> when it released later that year on [[November 11]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The Navy appears in the second level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Spinnaker's Spoils," although it is only identified within the strategy guide.<ref name="Prima" />

In the game, the Navy's boats are included as part of the Naboo Royal Navy's forces.<ref name="GB" /> Destroying the Navy is not essential for the player to complete the level, but the strategy guide recommends it. The strategy guide also states that the Navy has [[Missile Destroyer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|anti-air destroyers]] that the player should eliminate with their [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]];<ref name="Prima" /> however, the Navy's anti-air destroyers did not appear in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''.<ref name="GB" />
